2a. Promotion / Career Advancement / Higher Scale Movement

Fixation Rule Settings: Functional post promotions grant an extra increment before matching the target scale. Higher scale movements for qualification/upgradations bypass the promotional increment step. Upon promotion, post-promotion annual increment dates are strictly governed with respect to the Date of Promotion (as per ROPA rules): in ROPA-1998, the increment month shifts to the promotion month; in ROPA-2009/2019, if service in the promoted post as on 1st July is less than 6 months (promotion date between 2nd Jan and 30th Jun), the 1st July increment of that year is skipped and granted on 1st July of the next year.

Same-Date CAS + Promotion Rule: If the 10-Year, 18-Year or 20-Year CAS/benefit date falls on the exact Date of Promotion, the CAS benefit is first calculated/fixed on the pre-promotion pay. The promotion is then applied on the same date as the subsequent fixation event. Thus the Annexure-1 gross/arrear calculation for that CAS benefit uses the pre-promotion pay; the promoted pay applies from the promotion event onward.

3. ROPA-1998 Pre-2006 Fixation (Always Frozen on 31-03-2009)

10/18/20-Year CAS Rule (ROPA-1998 phase): Regular annual increments fall on the 1st day of the Option/Fixation month as usual. 10/18/20-Year CAS dates are deferred by LWP days if entered.

4. ROPA-2009 Notional Fixation (01-04-2009 to 31-12-2019)

ROPA-2009 Rule-II Carry-Forward: When ROPA-1998 is applicable, the ROPA-2009 opening Band Pay is calculated from the ROPA-1998 Basic Pay as on 01-01-2006: Basic × 1.86, rounded UP to the next Rs.10. The applicable Grade Pay on 01-01-2006 is then added. Example: Rs.8,050 × 1.86 = Rs.14,973 → Rs.14,980 + GP Rs.4,800 = Rs.19,780. The manual ROPA-2009 Initial Band Pay is ignored when this carry-forward applies.
LWP / Notional Increment Rule (G.O. No. 181-SE(B) Dt. 8.10.2009): Regular annual increments fall on the 1st day of July (01-07-YYYY). Extraordinary Leave Without Pay on medical grounds does not defer increment. Personal LWP defers financial benefit while future 1-July cycle dates stay fixed.

7. Arrear Period & Sub-Period Tool

Benefit w.e.f. / Arrear From = 18-Years CAS date in the generated Pay Table; Arrear To = day before “Salary Updated / Drawn Revised From”. Editing any of these dates by hand switches this off.
Each row = DA % that applies from that month onward (until the next row). Before the first row, the Base DA Rate above is used. W.B. Govt. DA: 18% up to Sep-2026, 38% from Oct-2026.
M.A. auto-defaults to ₹300 (ROPA-2009 era, before 01-01-2020) or ₹500 (ROPA-2019 era, from 01-01-2020) per month — editable per row in the table below.
I.R. (Interim Relief) auto-defaults to 10% of Basic Pay as on 01-01-2016 for months Jan-2016 to Dec-2019 (Grade Pay counted in full), 0 otherwise — editable per row.

Swasthya Sathi Card — Beneficiary & Surrender (after payment of the over-drawn amount)
Reference copy — Order No. 92-F(MED)WB dt. 09.10.2026 (Finance Dept., Medical Cell):
Dependent Beneficiaries Whose Card Is Surrendered (Annexure-A & Form D table; leave blank = employee + card holder are filled automatically)
Web-verified rules (Finance Dept., Medical Cell, Order No. 92-F(MED)WB dt. 09.10.2026): all employees / pensioners and their beneficiaries holding Swasthya Sathi / Ayushman Bharat cards while enrolled under WBHS must surrender them to the respective issuing authority; a declaration in Annexure-A with proof / acknowledgement of surrender goes to the Head of Office; last date 31.10.2026. District Swasthya Sathi sections work under the District Magistrate’s office; portal swasthyasathi.gov.in, helpline 1800-345-5384. Annexure-A is printed exactly as in the Order you uploaded. Form D (surrender / cancellation of the card) is a Swasthya Sathi Cell form; its official layout could not be downloaded, so the page printed here carries the same particulars — copy onto the official Form D if the D.M. office insists.
Default = FULL CARD surrender: the Order directs surrender of the card itself (no partial name deletion is provided in it), so all letters ask for the entire card with all members to be cancelled; Form D and Annexure-A list every member. Switch “Extent of Surrender” only if the issuing office permits name deletion alone.
Who surrenders: where the card is in the name of a non-employee spouse (wife / housewife), the card holder herself applies directly to the District Swasthya Sathi section / issuing authority, with a self-declaration of non-employment and the employee’s Annexure-A. The D.I. (S.E.) is the controlling officer of the employee only and is not the authority for the spouse’s card, so the D.I. is merely kept informed by copy. Documents for the D.I. route are shown only when “Employee applies through H.O.I. / D.I.” is chosen.
